about: BandWith screen map, generated by the crawler in e2e/crawl from the demo build. A state is a screen as the user sees it: page path + active tab (or screen heading) + the stack of open layers (kind:name) + the selected tab inside the top layer. Digits are normalised in the signature. Each action is one control that was on top: kind navigate (to = state id), inplace (content changed, same state), toast, db (only the demo database changed), scroll, dead (nothing happened), terminal (destructive/outward: never clicked, "to" says why), field (text input, not clicked), sampled (one of many identical rows), skipped (cap/budget), leaves (loaded another page), error (click failed). back.escape / back.system (browser Back = Android Back) say where Escape and system Back go; back.visible is the Back/Close control. health = page-health check of e2e/support/health.ts; axe = axe-core violations by impact (wcag2a/aa) scoped to the top layer. screenshot paths are relative to this file.
